introHtml: Black outdoor blankets offer a versatile, professional look that hides dirt and wear better than lighter colors. Whether you are outfitting a company picnic, a trade show giveaway, or a corporate retreat, black blankets coordinate with any logo and color scheme. Many of our options, like the Roll-Up Fleece Blanket with Handle or the KOOZIE® Field Blanket, feature water-resistant backing and convenient carrying handles, making them practical for outdoor use. Choose custom decoration via screen printing or embroidery to make your brand stand out.
